create_latent_upsampler: create a LatentUpsampler to upsample VAE latents spatially and temporally with configurable channels and dimensions
build_spatial_rational_resampler: build a SpatialRationalResampler for rational spatial scaling using pixel shuffle and anti-aliased downsampling
create_pixel_shuffle_nd: create a PixelShuffleND module for N-dimensional tensor upsampling with configurable upscale factors
build_blur_downsample: build a BlurDownsample layer for anti-aliased spatial downsampling using a binomial kernel
